calibration: 64 legal development pilot positions; no final test data
scope_selection: Prefer 160 if actual intended INT8 execution is verified and the expanded/original host-pipeline latency ratio is <=1.10 at batches 1 and 8. Normalize each candidate by its contemporaneously paired F16_TRT timing to control between-run clock/temperature drift.
numerical_acceptance: Require finite outputs, normalized WDL and nonnegative moves-left. Report policy/WDL drift and move agreement without choosing exclusions from prediction errors. A naive precision-loss result is a research measurement, not a reason to silently relax baseline limits.
note: Comparison clarified before either INT8 execution audit; graph implementation repairs are diagnostic failures, not new tuned scope candidates.
